agents.connect.title: Connect agent
agents.connect.description: Connect an agent over the A2A protocol
agents.connect.url.intro: ContextForge will read the agent's Agent Card to discover its skills, capabilities, and authentication requirements. If the agent doesn't publish a card, enter its details manually. The agent should be running.
agents.connect.url.label: URL
agents.connect.url.info: The agent's base URL, or the direct URL of its Agent Card (for example https://agent.example.com/.well-known/agent-card.json).
agents.connect.url.placeholder: Add URL for a running agent...
agents.connect.url.invalid: Enter a valid http or https URL.
agents.connect.outcome.noCard: Agent card not available: add the details for a running agent manually.
agents.connect.outcome.authRequired: The agent needs credentials to share its card: add the details for the agent manually.
agents.connect.outcome.unreachable: Couldn't reach the agent: check the URL, or add the details for a running agent manually.
agents.connect.outcome.error: Couldn't read the agent card: add the details for a running agent manually.
agents.connect.auth.title: Authenticate agent
agents.connect.auth.intro: Add the required credentials from the agent provider to connect the agent.
agents.connect.auth.introNone: This agent doesn't require credentials. Choose who can see it.
agents.connect.auth.credentialsRequired: Enter the credentials the agent requires.
agents.connect.auth.teamRequired: Choose a team for this agent.
agents.connect.auth.unsupported: This agent uses OAuth 2.0, which can't be set up from this form yet.
agents.connect.error.incompleteCard: The Agent Card is missing a name or endpoint, so the agent can't be registered.
agents.connect.error.create: Failed to connect the agent. Try again.
agents.connect.manual.name.label: Name
agents.connect.manual.name.required: Enter a name for the agent.
agents.connect.manual.endpoint.label: Endpoint URL
agents.connect.manual.endpoint.info: The address ContextForge sends requests to when it calls this agent.
agents.connect.manual.endpoint.invalid: Enter a valid http or https endpoint URL.
agents.connect.manual.binding.label: Protocol binding
